title: Email to Pen Pal: My School Eco-Project
instructions: Write an email (80-120 words) to your exchange friend Alex. Describe your school eco-project, explain what you did, and invite Alex to participate.
requiredPrompts: Friendly greeting and inquiry about friend's news
Description of the eco-project (recycling, tree planting)
Warm closing and question for reply
sampleTemplate:
Dear Alex,

How are things going? I hope you are having a wonderful week.

I am writing to share exciting news about our school eco-club! Last week, we launched a plastic recycling challenge. In addition, our class planted ten oak saplings near the sports ground. However, sorting paper was more difficult than we expected because many bins were mixed up.

Are there any green projects at your school? Let me know soon!

Best wishes,
Sam

title: Blog: Top 3 Habits of a Mindful Student
instructions: Write a blog post (80-120 words) for the school website with tips on keeping balanced, healthy, and happy during school exams.
sampleTemplate:
Finding Balance During Study Weeks!

School life can be busy, but staying healthy is our number one priority. Firstly, make sure you sleep at least eight hours every night so your brain can recharge. Moreover, drink plenty of water and take fresh-air breaks every hour. Finally, remember to enjoy your favorite hobby because relaxation keeps your mind sharp.

What is your favorite way to unwind? Share your thoughts below!

title: Poster: Save Energy at School!
instructions: Draft text for an awareness poster (70-100 words) encouraging classmates to turn off lights, shut computers down, and save electricity.
requiredPrompts: Simple action steps every student can take right now
sampleTemplate:
Small Actions, Big Impact: Power Down!

Did you know that leaving monitors on standby wastes tons of electricity every year? Therefore, we must act together! First, switch off the lights whenever leaving an empty classroom. In addition, remember to unplug chargers when your tablet is full. As a result, our school can reduce its carbon footprint.

Every switch counts. Turn it off today!
